name: motif_assess
description:
Measure a Selection. Runs PanGloss over chosen Texts or word forms and stores the resulting Assessments. After FieldWorks saves project changes, capture a new Baseline before measuring them. A word whose lowercase form differs and is not listed is also parsed as an extra row marked lowercaseOf, so the result reports inputWords and lowercaseWords separately.
Command: assess. Agent class: Evaluate.
no_background: True runs any Baseline recapture this needs in the foreground only: no Source index or Parsimony job is queued and no runner is woken, so nothing commits after the command returns.

words.description: Words to assess; omit for the Default Selection.

words_file.description: Path to a UTF-8 file with one word per line, or word, a tab, then a count, instead of words; counts are used only when the file is saved with the Selection.

assessment.description: A stored Assessment id from an earlier result: page its words instead of measuring again.

offset.description: Words to skip when paging. Default 0.

no_background.description: True runs any Baseline recapture in the foreground only: no Source index or Parsimony job is queued and no runner is woken, so nothing commits after the tool returns.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: Page size for paged reads (findings, operations: default 10; proposals list: default 25), and the most list items in concise mode elsewhere (default 25).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
